# Since scipy is not available, compute chi-square manually or just report within-site effects
# We'll compute response rates by site and arm without chi-square

treatment_effect_by_site = []

for site in data['site'].unique():
    site_data = data[data['site'] == site]
    trt_rate = site_data[site_data['arm'] == 'treatment']['responded'].mean()
    ctrl_rate = site_data[site_data['arm'] == 'control']['responded'].mean()
    effect = trt_rate - ctrl_rate
    treatment_effect_by_site.append((site, trt_rate, ctrl_rate, effect))

# Convert to DataFrame for clarity
